integrity: Exact finite-horizon Bellman and moment tests are reproducible; infinite-state assertions rely on proofs in RESULT.md, not finite computation.
scientific_limitations: Only cycles with independent with-replacement two-neighbor offers; no other graph family or correlated offers. All-horizon stochastic optimum and a central limit theorem under the stated controller are proved; absolute historical priority and independent verification are not certified.
title: Stochastic-order optimality and Gaussian fluctuations of two-choice cycle coverage
